statements.t: Additionally, we are excited by progress in our juvenile dermatomyositis program and expect to have a robust dataset from these patients to include with our planned BLA submission in myositis in the first quarter of 2028, potentially enabling our eligibility for a Priority Review Voucher.

In parallel, our PC-free program continues to build toward a dataset that will guide our path forward on the optimal dose and development strategy, which we plan to announce in the first half of 2027.”
The Company expects that its cash position as of September 30, 2026, will enable it to fund its operating plan into the first quarter of 2028.
